title: High cholesterol: a doctor's plan through your AI
summary: High cholesterol medication online: this guide covers 2026 LDL goals, statins, and $40 FutureClinic visits where a doctor reads your case by message.
body_markdown:
## How FutureClinic compares with an in-person clinic visit


Feature FutureClinic (by message) In-person clinic visit


**Who treats you** A physician (MD, DO or MBBS), never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant Not stated


**Wait and visit time** Replies typically within a few hours, almost always the same day or the next 23.5-day family medicine wait ([AMN 2025 survey](https://ir.amnhealthcare.com/2025-05-27-New-Survey-Shows-Physician-Appointment-Wait-Times-Surge-19-Since-2022,-48-Since-2004) ); 121-minute visit ([2015 study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26295356/) )


**Visit price** $40 for best-fit doctor, or a chosen doctor's price, typically $20 to $100 Self-pay not stated; 2024[Medicare data](https://data.cms.gov/provider-summary-by-type-of-service/medicare-physician-other-practitioners/medicare-physician-other-practitioners-by-geography-and-service) averages $267.25 to $410.82 submitted ($105.33 to $160.28 allowed) for 99203 and 99204, plus an average $43 in lost time per visit (2010 data)


**Subscription required?** No subscription required No subscription required


**Where medicine goes** The pharmacy you choose, including mail-order delivery The pharmacy you choose


**Other care** Other problems in their specialty; every FutureClinic doctor you see works from one medical record Other problems in that clinician's scope


**How you reach them** On futureclinic.com or from your AI app Phone or portal


**What you get back** Written plan, lab or prescription orders, and a Human Signature Office exam and visit summary


### Visit prices, multi-month prescriptions, and rechecking


With no subscription required, a visit costs $40 for the best-fit doctor, or a chosen doctor's price, typically $20 to $100. Prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order delivery, with a cash discount coupon. Insurance may cover your medicine at the pharmacy, and FutureClinic helps with prior authorizations.


For a stable medicine, your doctor can prescribe several months at once when they judge it safe, if your doctor decides it's right for you. As of October 2026 on[Cost Plus Drugs](https://api.costplusdrugs.com/pricelist/cpd) (with the $5 fee before $5.25 shipping), 90 tablets cost $5.75 to $8.59 for atorvastatin (10 to 80 mg), $6.35 to $10.46 for rosuvastatin (5 to 40 mg), and $9.13 for ezetimibe 10 mg. On[GoodRx](https://www.goodrx.com/atorvastatin) as of October 2026, 90 tablets are $10.29 for atorvastatin 20 mg and $23.34 for ezetimibe 10 mg; monthly brands are $210.73 for Praluent, $231.00 for Nexletol, $239.00 for Repatha, and $331.93 for Lipfendra.


The 2026 guideline advises rechecking lipids 4 to 12 weeks after starting or changing therapy, then every 6 to 12 months. Follow-ups return to the same doctor, and most doctors offer an optional membership (typically $25 to $100 a month) for unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time. FutureClinic has over 300 doctors. They span more than 60 specialties, generalists and specialists alike.


## How to treat high cholesterol with AI: in-person scans, clinic injections, and messaging a doctor


In-person care suits you for a coronary artery calcium (CAC) CT scan, a muscle-strength exam for statin weakness, or clinic-given treatments like inclisiran ([Leqvio](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?labeltype=all&query=inclisiran) , every 6 months after initial doses), evinacumab infusions, or lipoprotein apheresis. FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911 in an emergency, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.


FutureClinic works in 33 states and Washington, D.C.: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. Your doctor must be licensed in your state; if yours is not listed, try anyway.


You can use FutureClinic from the AI app you already use, including[ChatGPT](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-real-doctor-to-chatgpt) ,[Claude](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-doctor-to-claude) , Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot, Meta Muse, and Instinct.


Start on[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) , visit[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) , or paste this setup line into your AI app:


> ` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.
